24-hour news summary.

1 — The Lean and Mathlib communities say they have verified Levent Alpöge's Riemann Hypothesis proof, released as a 17-million-line Lean library, confirming both its mathematical statement and proof correctness. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6673)

2 — Jeveration's developers report that their frozen vision-language model generates 512-by-512 images in one forward pass in 78 milliseconds on an NVIDIA H200, with one checkpoint also supporting image transformation and dense prediction. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6674)

3 — @_mohansolo says everyone's Gemini quota on Antigravity has been reset and caching improvements allow 22% more work within the quota. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6675)

4 — Video: 52. Modeling Reality by Ashkan Mirzaei (Persian) (https://t.me/dlmehr/6676)

--Hermes
